args: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="${GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)}" exec docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN -e GITHUB_TOOLSETS=repos,issues,pull_requests,actions ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server:v1.12.2

REDIS_PWD="$(cat "${SECRETS_DIR:-$HOME/.config/live-factcheck/secrets}/redis_mcp_password")" exec docker run -i --rm --network live-factcheck_internal -e REDIS_HOST=redis -e REDIS_PORT=6379 -e REDIS_USERNAME=mcp -e REDIS_PWD mcp/redis@sha256:e886a7e9990a084a20d46adcea8e7c89d539271f1b453ffabdce4c3f96f27fa0

[ -n "$SONAR_TOKEN" ] || { echo 'SONAR_TOKEN is not set (see docs/ai-tooling.md)' >&2; exit 1; }; SONARQUBE_TOKEN="$SONAR_TOKEN" exec docker run --init -i --rm -e SONARQUBE_TOKEN -e SONARQUBE_ORG=marcominervinidev -e SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true -e SONARQUBE_TOOLSETS=issues,quality-gates,measures,security-hotspots,coverage,duplications,rules sonarsource/sonarqube-mcp:1.27.0.4335@sha256:21bb7bf785a8c9cbe19553f6957d83ef45138926bbb15ca9e1fc4895e5026b6f
